claims: Overloading extension cords by plugging in too many high-wattage appliances generates excessive heat.
Using damaged or frayed cords can cause electrical sparks and short circuits.
Running extension cords under rugs or carpets traps heat and prevents it from dissipating safely.

claims.text: A large proportion of structure fires are caused by extension cords that are either damaged or overloaded.
Overloading causes an extension cord to heat up until its insulation melts or carbonizes.
Covering an extension cord with a rug or carpet can produce a serious fire hazard.
